scope: Exact application artifact under mandatory runtime mitigations; not a CVE suppression or material-risk acceptance

findings.rationale: bsdutils: Failed privileged mount helper post-hooks require SUID/CAP_SYS_ADMIN and authorized mount. Runtime UID 10001, all capability sets zero, NoNewPrivs=1, Seccomp=2, no SUID/SGID and no fstab entries exclude privileged hooks. HELIX never calls mount.

bsdutils: Requires a privileged nsenter --join-cgroup operator retaining a root-opened host cgroup FD. Container has no host cgroup bind, no capabilities, no SUID and runs only unprivileged Python with no nsenter call or inherited host cgroup FD.

bsdutils: Requires Linux >=6.15 detached-tree fast path, authorized fstab X-mount.subdir and privileged mount. Host kernel 6.8, empty fstab, no capabilities/SUID and no HELIX mount calls exclude these prerequisites.
bsdutils: Requires privileged SUID restricted bind mount from writable fstab source. Image has no SUID/SGID or fstab entries, read-only root and no capabilities; HELIX has no mount invocation.

libacl1: Path-based ACL operations require privileged libacl caller and attacker-controlled pathname. HELIX has no ACL API/CLI or ctypes call, libacl is not loaded by Python, runtime is UID 10001 with no caps/SUID; root is read-only. No privileged ACL processing of uploads exists.
